Analysis › Drag ligand atom moves one atom on screen, tidies the bonds, then runs the same minimisation. Translate rigid ligand moves the whole ligand without changing its shape, then runs the same minimisation. Ctrl+Z restores the ligand position. Analysis › Distance constraint flags poses that are too far from one or two residues (a pose passes if either is close enough) and shows the best-scoring pose that passes.
